steps.u: Our resize worker hangs forever on certain uploads, no crash, no log. Don't fix anything yet, I want to know why.

steps.r:
Thread 0 (idle): MainThread

steps.a: The loop only ends when it finds an EXIF marker in a chunk. On images without EXIF, read returns empty bytes at end of file, the check never matches, and the loop spins forever. The stack dump shows the worker sitting in exactly that loop. I haven't changed it.
